## Scope and approval

- Work-package or change reference:
- Exact target files and excluded scope:
- Approval basis, or PENDING if not yet approved:
- Authorized package/version or manifest digest:

This is a local review template. Its presence does not create a public repository or PR, authorize a Git operation, establish a license, or approve the change.

## Actual validation evidence

- Environment and working directory:
- Exact commands actually run:
- Exit status and actual results:
- Preserved failures or UNKNOWN fields:
- Checks NOT_RUN and why:
- Before/after bytes or SHA evidence:
- Independent review status and evidence:

Do not fill a future expected result in as an observed PASS. Historical test counts apply only to their recorded snapshots.

## Disclosure and review checklist

Leave unchecked until actual evidence supports the item.

- [ ] The change follows the [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Fixed parent contracts and FAIL/UNKNOWN/PROPOSED distinctions are preserved.
- [ ] No credentials, private research records, author replies or held-out data are included.
- [ ] AI assistance, third-party sources and unresolved rights are described.
- [ ] Claims respect the [evidence boundaries](../docs/research-evidence.md).
- [ ] Actual validation and independent review are linked; unperformed checks are NOT_RUN.

These boxes are review aids, not human signatures, publication approval, rights clearance or proof of general task correctness.
